nodes.name: Nightly Trigger
nodes.notes: 03:17 Europe/London. Off-the-hour on purpose: 03:00 is when every scheduled job on the internet fires at once.

nodes.name: Run Config
nodes.notes: All caps and knobs. Resets the run accumulator.

nodes.name: Sign Worklist Request
nodes.notes: HMAC over `${ts}.` (empty body).

nodes.name: GET Worklist
nodes.notes: Our own API. neverError so a 401 is inspectable data, not an opaque node failure.

nodes.name: Worklist To Items
nodes.notes: One item per product. Applies the cap a second time.

nodes.name: Loop Products
nodes.notes: batchSize 1 = concurrency 1. Never raise this; parallel requests are what gets an IP blocked. Output 0 = done, output 1 = loop.

nodes.name: Polite Delay
nodes.notes: Randomised 6–14s between products. Also enforces the halt.

nodes.name: Search Euronics
nodes.notes: GET /search?text=<productCode>. Honest UA with a contact address — no browser spoofing.

nodes.name: Parse Search HTML
nodes.notes: First /catalogue/.../p/<SKU> link, SKU-matched where possible.

nodes.name: IF Search Blocked
nodes.notes: true = 403/429/503 or a Cloudflare challenge. Exits the loop.

nodes.name: IF Product Found
nodes.notes: false = no product page for this code. Recorded as not_found, never dropped.

nodes.name: Fetch PDP
nodes.notes: Second and last request for this product. Two requests per product, no images, no assets.

nodes.name: Extract Price
nodes.notes: PRIMARY "price": "N"  |  FALLBACK modal £N. Records the observation.

nodes.name: IF PDP Blocked
nodes.notes: The PDP can be blocked even when search was not. Same rule: stop, do not retry.

nodes.name: Record Not Found
nodes.notes: Stores the miss so "we cannot benchmark this" is visible.

nodes.name: Record Blocked And Halt
nodes.notes: Sets the halt flag and exits the loop into the flush.

nodes.name: Build Observation Batch
nodes.notes: Builds the exact JSON string that gets signed and sent.

nodes.name: Sign Observations Post
nodes.notes: HMAC over `${ts}.${rawBody}`, generated just before the POST.

nodes.name: POST Observations
nodes.notes: contentType RAW on purpose. If n8n re-serialises the JSON, one reordered key breaks the HMAC and the route 401s.

nodes.name: Run Summary
nodes.notes: Throws on a halted or rejected run so the execution shows as failed.
